name: Lois
overview: Lois is a female biblical figure known primarily as the grandmother of Timothy, as noted in 2 Timothy 1:5. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional personal details recorded about her in Scripture. Her significance is tied closely to her role within Timothy's family and faith heritage.
namesAndTitles: The only recorded name for this person is Lois, which is presented as a proper name in the New Testament. No specific meaning or divine origin of the name is provided in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Lois as the grandmother of Timothy, establishing a direct familial connection. Beyond this, no other family relationships are documented in the biblical record.
scriptureSignificance: Lois is significant in the biblical narrative for her role in the spiritual upbringing of Timothy, as indicated by her mention in 2 Timothy 1:5. Her faith and influence are implied to have been instrumental in passing down sincere faith to Timothy, highlighting the importance of godly heritage in the Christian life. Though brief, her mention underscores the value of faithful women in nurturing future leaders of the church.
